newFindings.title: Type with many members
newFindings.rationale: Large types often become aggregation points for unrelated behavior.

architecture-review.json.review: One Workbench authority implements existing publication/active-work ports. Exact inherited snapshot selection, current source/executor ceilings and cached canonical parent stay within that publication lifetime. The existing publisher orders Project locks before the Process selected fence and rechecks after flush. No module/project edge, registration, query family or runtime partial is introduced. The new informational12-member cohesive authority finding is reviewed and retained; existing one module/five type cycles and204 diagnostics remain. Direct Release compilation and actual integration proof are required separately.

validation.cause: Both expiry fixtures attempt CheckpointSavedEffectAsync after the original parent claim expired; the publication refusal and no-effect outcome were already recorded.
validation.followUp: Repeat full selection after explicit outcome-only fixture path. Add current executor profile-generation check and before/after-flush races for operator launches; do not rely only on launching-Agent generation.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: Initial64 inherited publication selection:62 pass; two expiry fixtures incorrectly attempt parent continuation after the effect refusal is retained. Production review additionally requires an explicit executor profile-generation recheck for operator-launched Processes. Both will be corrected and the complete selection repeated. Historical cleanup denials remain unchanged.
